title: Lean 11 Master Architecture

canonical_node.axiom: The corpus must be represented as a complete, honest, and buildable Lean 4 architecture that matches the intended whole, not merely the currently compiled subset.
definitions: Canonical stack: the intended 11-part architecture (Foundational Core, Stage and Sequence Discipline, Mapping Layer, Bridge Matrix, Field Controls and Invariance, Score and Constraint Discipline, Polarity and Fracture Mechanics, Memory Persistence and Conversion, Christ/Mediation/Justice Operators, Chi Evaluation and Adversarial Testing, Isomorphism and Consilience Layer).

Compiled packet: the currently compiling set of Lean files (Theophysics_Core.lean, Final_Lean4_From_Excel.lean, Theophysics_Coherence.lean, Theophysics_ChiEvaluator.lean, Theophysics_Fall.lean, Theophysics_Fracture.lean, Theophysics_Adversarial.lean).
Gap set: modules present in workbook/architecture but not yet in the active root package.

Status vocabulary: COMPILED_NOW, SCaffolded, EXCEL_ONLY, NEEDS_DEFINITION_EXPANSION, BLOCKED_BY_IMPORTS, DEMOTED_TO_TEACHING_LAYER, RETIRED; roll-up: LEAN_PROVEN, STRUCTURALLY_MAPPED, THEOLOGICALLY_IDENTIFIED.
derivation: The current repo compiles as a seven-file staged packet.
The Excel workbook is larger than the compiled repo and serves as a map of the broader architecture.
To carry the whole framework honestly, the repo must expand to an eleven-part canonical architecture.
The gap set lists modules that need to be promoted into the root package.
Build doctrine requires keeping one small compiling package, expanding definitions before rhetoric, promoting modules one at a time, and recording status after each promotion.
The recommended build order lists the sequence of promotions to reach the full eleven-part chain.
canonical_node.action: Maintain a single compiling Lean package; expand definitions before rhetoric; promote modules from the gap set into the root package one at a time; after each promotion run 'lake build', record warnings, theorem coverage, and what remains Excel-only; never let workbook and repo drift silently; use the status vocabulary to mark every theorem or claim.
boundary: This document does not itself prove any theorem; it defines an architecture and a build discipline.
It does not claim that the eleven-part architecture is already compiled; it identifies the gap set.
It does not authorize using the word 'derived' where the real status is identification.
It does not specify the exact Lean code for each module; it specifies the intended content and role.
test: Check that the repo always has at least one small compiling package.
Check that after each promotion, 'lake build' succeeds and warnings are recorded.
Check that every theorem or claim in the workbook is marked with one of the status vocabulary terms.
Check that the repo does not use 'derived' lazily where the real status is identification.
Check that the workbook and repo do not drift silently; i.e., the gap set is tracked and reduced.

dg1_dependencies: Existing compiled packet (Theophysics_Core, Final_Lean4_From_Excel, Theophysics_Coherence, Theophysics_ChiEvaluator, Theophysics_Fall, Theophysics_Fracture, Theophysics_Adversarial)
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Defines a target end-to-end Lean 4 architecture (11 parts) and a build discipline to expand the current seven-file packet into that whole, including a status vocabulary and promotion order.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: The existing seven-file compiling packet remains the current executable subset and must be kept green; the architecture does not discard it.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If this architecture document is removed, the repo may continue to compile but the target end-to-end shape and the discipline for expanding to the full corpus would be lost, risking silent drift between workbook and repo.
dg5_translation_registers: Status vocabulary: COMPILED_NOW, SCaffolded, EXCEL_ONLY, NEEDS_DEFINITION_EXPANSION, BLOCKED_BY_IMPORTS, DEMOTED_TO_TEACHING_LAYER, RETIRED
Build doctrine steps: keep compiling package, expand definitions, promote modules, run lake build, record warnings/coverage/Excel-only

classification.recommended_atom_action: Adopt as a planning and governance document; do not treat as a formal proof artifact.

overstatement_risks: The document describes an intended architecture, not a proven one; treating it as a proof of the full chain would be overstatement.
The phrase 'canonical stack' might imply the modules are already formalized; they are not all compiled.
The build order is a recommendation, not a verified sequence; promoting modules may encounter unforeseen issues.
kill_conditions: If the repo is allowed to drift from the workbook without tracking, the architecture becomes aspirational rather than operational.
If the status vocabulary is not enforced, the honesty discipline fails.
If the build is not kept green, the foundation collapses.
risk.lean_target: Formalize the 11-part architecture as a set of Lean modules with clear dependencies and statuses; ensure each module compiles and the whole chain is buildable.

plain_summary: This document outlines a target 11-part Lean 4 architecture for the Faith Thru Physics corpus, expanding the current seven-file compiling packet. It defines the intended modules, a build doctrine, and a status vocabulary to track progress. It is a planning document, not a proof artifact; its value is in guiding the expansion and maintaining honesty about what is proven versus mapped versus identified.
